name: io.github.edouard-claude/henrri-mcp
title: Henrri (unofficial)
description: Unofficial Henrri invoicing: customers, quotes, invoices, milestones, payments, webhooks.

environmentVariables.name: HENRRI_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Henrri API user login (or set HENRRI_CLIENT_ID and HENRRI_CLIENT_SECRET)

environmentVariables.name: HENRRI_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Developer client id, instead of a user

environmentVariables.name: HENRRI_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: 1 to withhold every write tool (finalize, pay, delete…)

environmentVariables.name: HENRRI_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets: account, customers, documents, catalog, payments, revenues, webhooks
